text: I feel a curious anticipation, pausing before the transparent barrier to an illuminated room filled with silent waiting chairs and flickering screens. As I enter and stand before the vibrant wall that declares R+D, I sense the pulse of innovation and inquiry. The blend of carefully chosen words and displays invites contemplation—a space built for thinking, for pushing boundaries, for exploring the unknown. I am both participant and observer, exhilarated to be immersed in a shrine to restless curiosity and the ceaseless search for meaning.
